title: Playbook
description: The repeatable deliverables of each client, priced by outcome. Add the ones a month needs from its cycle.
emptyDescription: Add the deliverables you repeat for a client, with the price the client pays for the outcome.

import.title: Import repeatable tasks
import.description: A CSV with the columns client, deliverable, price, billing, cadence, quarter month and estimate hours. Client is the first part of the initiative title (GSG for "GSG — leads"). Nothing is written until you press Apply, and items already in the playbook are skipped.
import.setup: Also set up MGM (consulting management) and a quarterly strategic review per committed client, and mark the known clients committed or new
